**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Chat
- **Grok replies no longer run two messages together.** When Grok writes a short preamble before a web search and then the answer as a second message, the two were glued together with no space ("…Kinderlosigkeit.Teilweise ja…"). They are now separated by a paragraph break — the same fix 8.23 made for Gemini.
- The debug log now records how many messages, characters and event types each Grok/OpenAI-compatible reply stream contained, to diagnose replies that stop after one sentence.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.24...v8.25
